en: A colorized historic panoramic view of a dense district with long, rectangular barracks-like buildings featuring red-tiled roofs, set in a valley surrounded by hills or low mountains. The foreground shows several multi‑story masonry buildings and tree‑lined streets; in the lower right corner there is a small building with a green dome. At the top of the image there is printed text identifying the scene as military barracks in Trento/Trient.
